highlights: The AI landscape is seeing rapid advancements in agentic systems, with significant progress in multi-agent coordination, tool-use chaining, and stable recursive self-improvement frameworks.

Major AI developers like OpenAI and Google DeepMind are releasing more powerful and cost-effective frontier models, featuring expanded context windows, multimodal video generation, and enhanced coding capabilities.

The ecosystem for AI builders is maturing with new developer tools, including orchestrator APIs for seamless multi-LLM integration, efficient tool retrieval for agents, and robust local inference solutions.

agents.title: Perplexity Computer Adds Multiagent: Up to 16 AI Agents That Cross-Check Work
agents.summary: Perplexity now allows up to 16 AI agents to collaborate on tasks within Computer, leveraging multiple foundation models to cross-check work and enhance reliability in complex problem-solving.

agents.title: Anthropic Adds Code Mode to Claude Code: Claude Now Chains Tool Calls in JavaScript
agents.summary: Anthropic's new Code Mode for Claude Code enables the model to write JavaScript that chains Bash, Read, and Edit calls in a single step, significantly enhancing its autonomous tool-use and scripting capabilities.

agents.title: GUARD: Stabilizing Recursive Self-Improvement with Regret Guidance
agents.summary: A new framework, GUARD, introduces a method for stable, reference-free continual evolution of AI agent harnesses, using directional regret to prevent regressions and optimize token usage during self-improvement.

models.title: Google DeepMind Releases Gemini 4 Neon: 1M Context, #1 on AA Coding Agent Index
models.summary: Google's new Gemini 4 Neon model boasts a 1M token context window and ranks #1 on the AA Coding Agent Index, offering superior performance for complex coding tasks at competitive pricing.

models.title: Introducing GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
models.summary: OpenAI has released GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, delivering improved professional outputs, coding, and computer interaction across ChatGPT Work and the API, with Astra's API costs reduced by 20%.

models.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips
models.summary: Google introduced Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, featuring native 15-second video generation and editing with enhanced consistency, alongside a 30% reduction in pricing for builders.

tools.title: Perplexity Launches Orchestrator API for Failover and Model Routing
tools.summary: Perplexity's new Orchestrator API offers a unified endpoint to manage and route requests across major LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI) and open-weight models, providing failover, unified billing, and intelligent routing.

tools.title: Introducing Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API
tools.summary: Google has launched Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API, enabling AI agents to access hundreds of tools more efficiently by significantly reducing token usage during complex tool-use scenarios.

tools.title: llama.cpp v1.0.0 : A stronger foundation for the local AI ecosystem
tools.summary: The release of llama.cpp v1.0.0 provides a more robust and accessible foundation for running open-source large language models locally, enhancing capabilities for on-device and resource-constrained AI development.

companies.title: Google Cloud launches Gemini for healthcare
companies.summary: Google Cloud has introduced Gemini for healthcare, a specialized offering designed to unify clinical data and automate workflows, aiming to reduce administrative burden and improve efficiency in the medical sector.

companies.title: Google Search gets a major upgrade with Gemini 4 Hydrogen
companies.summary: Google is integrating Gemini 4 Hydrogen into its Search platform globally, promising users more helpful, visual, and intuitive search responses powered by advanced AI.

companies.title: Broadening access to AI for scientists
companies.summary: OpenAI is expanding its ChatGPT for Academic Researchers program, offering free access to its frontier models for 200,000 researchers worldwide to accelerate scientific discovery and collaboration.

learning.title: Not If, But How: Responding to Security Incidents in the Age of AI Attackers
learning.summary: This guide provides a critical 4-pillar incident response playbook, informed by 6 months of incidents, to help organizations counter the growing threat of AI-powered attackers on AI infrastructure.

learning.title: Our newest AI Quest: Mapping the human brain
learning.summary: Google has released a new 'AI Quest' lesson called 'Polar Peaks,' offering an engaging educational pathway for AI literacy through the lens of neuroscience.

learning.title: The Definitive Fine-Tuning Guide for 3D Generation Models
learning.summary: Hugging Face has published a comprehensive guide for fine-tuning 3D generation models, providing essential knowledge and practical steps for developers working in this emerging field.
